Transfer of unaccompanied minors to the UK under Section 67 of the Immigration Act 2016, by latest outcome1, 2
1. As at the end of July 2020.

2. A grant of asylum is awarded in most cases, but in some cases where there is not an asylum claim, or a claim has been refused or withdrawn, then these cases are also eligible for other leave such as Section 67.

3. Latest outcome relates to the most recent outcome, as at the end of July 2020, of the individual's asylum application, where applicable. In cases where the individual has not lodged an asylum claim, or such a claim has been refused, the latest outcome will relate to the grant of Section 67 leave. Data are subject to change as cases progress.
